content.name: Construction toolkit v0 (modulable — le même mécanisme bâtit une room, une route ou une parcelle)
content.lineage: Composes the proven MutationBond write-path (crates/universe-e2e/src/mutation_translate.rs — project_mutation_bond -> translate_mutation_proposal / translate_mutation_receipt, four closed kernel verbs, content-contract enforced) into a SET aggregator. The earlier hand-built placement bin (place_built_position) has been DELETED; the proven path is now the generic translator plus the mcp act path (mcp/ sense+act adapter) that compiles a gesture into the same four verbs. Downstream of the layout-built-not-generated pivot AND the where-is-a-projection doctrine: placing/building a node IS a physicalized construction action, but WHERE it lands is never authored as a coordinate — it lives entirely in the authored RELATIONS (PART_OF its region; for a route, CONNECTS its two anchor nodes) and the coordinate is a live projection the single layout authority derives from that topology, read the same way by every observer. Sibling in form to the Underground toolkit v0 (same 12-role self-verifying anatomy), but a WRITE toolkit rather than a read-only substrate. PROVEN by crates/universe-e2e/src/bin/wield_construction.rs (furnishes a room AND a route as one atomic set each, over a scratch canonical-ontology store, with independent readback of the RELATIONS — no coordinate is ever written or read).

canonical_predicate_remap.why: The step template originally named HAS_POSITION, CONSTRUCTED_BY, JUSTIFIED_BY and CONNECTS, none of which are in the canonical seed predicate vocabulary (fixtures/ontology/canonical-ontology.json). Constructing with them would mint non-canonical symbols, violating the ZERO-new-symbols invariant. Each surviving one is remapped to the nearest ACTIVE-VOICE canonical predicate (documented like the orientation-beacon / energy-pen fixtures); the wield_construction bin asserts 0 symbols interned.

PART_OF.note: canonical already; region containment: structure PART_OF region. This is the primary placement relation — the region a structure belongs to is WHERE it is.

CONNECTS.note: route CONNECTS its from-anchor and to-anchor becomes route COMMUNICATES from-anchor and route COMMUNICATES to-anchor. The endpoints are OTHER NODES referenced by relation, NEVER coordinates. Remapped to the canonical COMMUNICATES (a civic route communicates/connects two places — 'voie de communication'); active-voice, source is the route; 0 new symbols. The route's place is fully carried by these two connection edges plus its PART_OF district.

CONSTRUCTED_BY.note: structure CONSTRUCTED_BY Moment becomes Moment PRODUCES structure — the construction Moment is the producer, the Built structure is its product. This is the SAME remap that canonicalizes mutation-bond-authority.json's own non-canonical CONSTRUCTED_BY overlay predicate; that authority fixture is owned by the write-path piece, so this toolkit conforms by emitting the canonical PRODUCES rather than editing it.

JUSTIFIED_BY.note: structure JUSTIFIED_BY justification becomes justification GROUNDS structure — the justification is the grounds for the structure; the narrative WHERE encodes WHY.

HAS_POSITION.note: GONE and moot. Position is never stored, never authored, never a literal — no built_position field, no position entity, no HAS_POSITION edge. Where a structure is lives entirely in its relations (PART_OF region; CONNECTS anchors for a route); the coordinate is a live projection derived from that topology by the single layout authority. There is nothing to remap because there is no position write.

parent_scope.justification: Portable construction toolkit awaiting installation under the canonical infrastructure/civic physicalization registry Space. It has exactly one scope classification and is not structurally owned by one exclusive parent yet; no PART_OF edge is written to an unbuilt parent.

modularity.rule: structure_kind selects the target scale, the geometry field-schema and the region kind. It is GRAPH DATA read from the ConstructionBond, never a term in native dispatch. The same generic mechanism is total over every declared kind; adding a kind is authoring data, not changing code.
modularity.placement_model: Placement is RELATIONAL, never a coordinate. Every structure is bound PART_OF its region (that containment IS where it is). A route additionally CONNECTS (canonical COMMUNICATES) its from-anchor and to-anchor — two OTHER NODES referenced by relation, so a route's whole place is its district plus its two endpoints. No structure carries a built_position field, an x/y/z, a path polyline or a boundary polygon; nothing stores a coordinate. The coordinate a renderer needs is a live projection the single layout authority derives from these relations, read the same way by every observer, and it may drift — the meaning is the stable authored topology, not any position value.
modularity.geometry_model: A structure's SIZE is a scalar property (a dimension, not a position): a room carries width/height/depth. Its PLACE is never a size and never a coordinate — it is the relations above. An unmeasured extent stays Fog (absent), never a zero-size default.

room.geometry: scalar size fields (width, height, depth) + membrane + door_ports. No coordinate literal.

route.geometry: no coordinate path; the route's shape is carried by its two anchor relations, not a polyline

parcel.geometry: no boundary polygon; a parcel's extent is expressed by CONNECTS (COMMUNICATES) edges to its corner-anchor nodes, never coordinate literals

content.native_law_boundary: The native floor knows only the four closed kernel write verbs (intern_symbols, put_entity, put_relation, tombstone_relation) and how to aggregate them into one atomic UniverseWriteSet. Construction is a physicalization grammar over that floor: structure_kind, geometry, the ordered step template and the region/connection metaphor are all Universe data. The floor adds no construction-specific predicate meaning, and it never stores a position — a coordinate is only ever a projection computed by the layout authority downstream of the relations.
content.purpose: Make CONSTRUCTION a wieldable graph gesture: turn 'build a room here' or 'lay a route between these anchors' into one atomic set of one-verb MutationBonds that puts a Built structure carrying its provenance, binds it PART_OF its region (and, for a route, CONNECTS its two anchor nodes), and attaches a construction Moment that PRODUCES it and a justification that GROUNDS it. WHERE the structure is lives entirely in those relations — no coordinate is ever written. The city is then the accumulated fold of attributable construction gestures over a stable authored topology, not a regenerated layout and not a bag of stored positions. One modular mechanism serves every structure_kind, and only canonical predicates (PART_OF, COMMUNICATES, PRODUCES, GROUNDS) are emitted — zero new symbols.

content.success_condition: For any declared structure_kind (room, route, parcel, ...), the SAME toolkit composes a single atomic UniverseWriteSet of one-verb MutationBonds that: puts a Built structure carrying provenance 'built' and its scalar geometry (a size, never a coordinate); binds it PART_OF its region; for a route additionally CONNECTS (canonical COMMUNICATES) its from-anchor and to-anchor OTHER NODES; attaches a construction Moment that PRODUCES the structure; and binds a justification that GROUNDS the structure. structure_kind and its geometry are read from the graph, never dispatched in native code. WHERE the structure is is fully carried by its relations — NO built_position, x/y/z, path or boundary literal is ever written. A construction that cannot furnish its full set commits nothing (all-or-nothing). Only the four closed kernel verbs are ever emitted, and only canonical predicates (PART_OF, COMMUNICATES, PRODUCES, GROUNDS) — zero new symbols interned.

content.pattern: A construction is not one write but a SET. The toolkit reifies a construction gesture as a ConstructionBond: an ordered set of one-verb MutationBonds (put_entity / put_relation / intern_symbols / tombstone_relation) that the generic mutation translator aggregates into exactly ONE UniverseWriteSet and commits at a tick boundary. The SET is the atomicity and identity unit ('lié au set'). The shape of the set is furnished by the graph: the ConstructionBond carries a structure_kind, so the same mechanism builds a room (infrastructure: a bounded Space with a size, a membrane and door ports, PART_OF a building) or a route (civic: an anchor CONNECTS-ing its two endpoint nodes, PART_OF a district) purely by varying that data. Placement is RELATIONAL: PART_OF the region for every kind, plus COMMUNICATES edges to the anchor nodes for a route. No coordinate is stored — a node's position is a live projection the single layout authority derives from these relations, read the same way by every observer; it may drift, and that is fine, because the authored topology is what is stable.
content.epistemic_honesty: A preview is not a built structure. WHERE is a projection, not a datum: no structure carries a coordinate, and a rendered position is derived, never authoritative. A partially-furnished set commits nothing rather than a half-built structure. An unmeasured extent is Fog, not a zero-size room. structure_kind is data; no structure_kind is privileged in native dispatch.

terms.ConstructionBond: The reified construction gesture: an ordered set of one-verb MutationBonds aggregated into ONE atomic UniverseWriteSet. The write-side aggregator that mirrors, at set granularity, what a single MutationBond does at verb granularity.
terms.StructureKind: The modular parameter (room | route | parcel | ...) selecting the target scale, the geometry field-schema and the region kind. Graph data, never native dispatch.
terms.BuiltStructure: The entity the set puts, carrying provenance 'built', its structure_kind and its scalar geometry (a size, never a coordinate). The durable, attributable result of the construction; its PLACE is not on this entity at all — it is carried by the entity's relations.
terms.ConstructionSet: The atomic all-or-nothing UniverseWriteSet a ConstructionBond commits. The SET is the identity and atomicity boundary; either every step commits or none does.
terms.Placement: WHERE a structure is, carried ENTIRELY by relations: PART_OF its region for every kind, plus CONNECTS (canonical COMMUNICATES) edges to its anchor nodes for a route. Never a stored coordinate; the renderable position is a live projection the layout authority derives from these relations.
terms.Region: The containing Space the structure is PART_OF: a building or parcel for a room, a district for a route, a territory for a parcel. The PART_OF region edge is the primary statement of where the structure belongs.
terms.Anchor: An OTHER NODE a route CONNECTS (COMMUNICATES) as one of its endpoints. A route references its from-anchor and to-anchor by relation, never by coordinate; the two anchors plus the district are the route's whole place.
terms.ConstructionMoment: The construction Moment that PRODUCES the structure (canonical PRODUCES, remapped from the ad-hoc CONSTRUCTED_BY) — the evidence that makes the construction gesture attributable and non-anonymous.
terms.Justification: The narrative that GROUNDS the structure (canonical GROUNDS, remapped from the ad-hoc JUSTIFIED_BY) — the reason the structure exists among its relations; the WHERE (topology) encodes WHY.
terms.MutationBond: The proven write-side primitive (one closed kernel verb per bond, content-contract enforced) this toolkit COMPOSES. Defined by mutation-bond-authority.json, not redefined here.

content.given: A declared structure_kind, its scalar geometry (a size for a room; for a route, its two anchor nodes), a target region Space, the acting actor's build capability, an attributable plan, and the MutationBond primitive vocabulary.
content.when: An actor issues a build/place construction gesture on a proven, buildable region (the affordance-catalog `build` verb) whose ConstructionBond is resolvable in the graph.
then: Resolve the ConstructionBond: read its structure_kind and its region/connection predicates from the toolkit kind_profiles.
Furnish the ordered set of one-verb MutationBonds for that kind; run each step's content gesture on the mutation-free VM.

Validate every content field against its field-schema; a missing or null required field is a Validation failure, never a default. Placement carries no fields to validate — it is relations, not content.

Translate each step through the generic mutation translator into exactly one UniverseCommand, and aggregate them into ONE UniverseWriteSet fronted by a single InternSymbols for any new canonical symbol.

Prepare and commit the set atomically at a tick boundary: put the BuiltStructure (provenance 'built', scalar geometry only), its PART_OF region edge, for a route its CONNECTS (COMMUNICATES) anchor edges, its construction Moment with a Moment-PRODUCES-structure edge, and its justification with a justification-GROUNDS-structure edge.
Read the whole structure back from a fresh reopen and assert the placement RELATIONS — never a coordinate.
Produce runtime validation_run / health_assessment moments from actual execution.
forbidden: committing a partial set (a half-built structure)
writing a coordinate in any form — a built_position field, an x/y/z, a path polyline or a boundary polygon (WHERE is a projection, not a datum)
hardcoding a structure_kind, metaphor or geometry in native dispatch instead of reading it from the graph
emitting a fifth write verb (only the four closed kernel verbs are representable)
writing a structure without a construction Moment that PRODUCES it (anonymous construction)
minting a non-canonical predicate (HAS_POSITION, CONNECTS, CONSTRUCTED_BY, JUSTIFIED_BY) instead of the canonical PART_OF / COMMUNICATES / PRODUCES / GROUNDS
referencing a route's endpoints as coordinates instead of CONNECTS relations to OTHER NODES
defaulting a missing geometry field instead of failing closed
rendering a preview as a committed structure
regenerating an authored arrangement on a new observation

steps: resolve the ConstructionBond: read structure_kind and its region/connection predicates from the toolkit kind_profiles

select the ordered one-verb step template for that structure_kind (placement is RELATIONS, canonical predicates only): put_entity structure {provenance 'built', scalar geometry} -> put_relation structure PART_OF region -> (route only) put_relation structure COMMUNICATES from-anchor -> put_relation structure COMMUNICATES to-anchor -> put_entity construction Moment -> put_relation Moment PRODUCES structure -> put_entity justification -> put_relation justification GROUNDS structure
run each step's content gesture (an IR program producing the content record) on the fuel-bounded, mutation-free VM
validate each content record against its field-schema; a missing or null required geometry field is a Validation error (there is no position field to validate — placement is relations)
translate each step through the generic mutation translator (translate_mutation_proposal / translate_mutation_receipt) into exactly one UniverseCommand
aggregate the commands into ONE UniverseWriteSet, fronted by a single InternSymbols for any new canonical symbol
prepare + commit the write-set atomically at the boundary tick

read the whole structure back from a fresh reopen; assert provenance 'built', all placement edges (PART_OF; COMMUNICATES anchors for a route) and the Moment — and that NO coordinate field exists on the structure
emit the construction receipt and run the independent observer and the structured evaluation AST
content.composition_is_data: The ordered step template per structure_kind lives in the graph (the ConstructionBond + its field-schema + the kind_profiles), not in native code. Adding a new structure_kind is authoring data; the runtime hardcodes no kind, metaphor, geometry or placement rule.
content.set_atomicity: The UniverseWriteSet is the atomicity and identity unit. UniverseTransaction::prepare validates the whole set before any command is published; a single invalid step publishes no valid prefix.
content.scheduler_projection: tick-boundary/1; one construction = one write-set committed at one tick boundary. Determinism is NOT required — only the committed relations are authoritative.

content.authority: Graph-native CodeDefinition projection composing the proven MutationBond write-path into a SET aggregator. This JSON file is a materialized projection, not independent semantic authority.

composes_primitive.set_model: the UniverseWriteSet is the atomic + identity unit — 'lié au set'; a placement/construction = a set of one-verb bonds that commit together
composes_primitive.content_contract: each written content record is validated against its field-schema; a missing required field fails closed. Placement carries no content — it is relations.

content.honesty: The Construction toolkit is materialized and shaped as a 12-role self-verifying construct whose central mechanism composes the ALREADY-PROVEN MutationBond primitive (mutation_translate.rs, green end-to-end) into an atomic SET. Placement is now fully RELATIONAL, per the where-is-a-projection doctrine: NO coordinate is written in any form — no built_position field, no x/y/z, no path, no boundary. WHERE a structure is lives in its relations (PART_OF region for every kind; CONNECTS -> canonical COMMUNICATES to the two anchor nodes for a route). Only canonical predicates are emitted (PART_OF kept; CONNECTS -> COMMUNICATES; CONSTRUCTED_BY -> PRODUCES; JUSTIFIED_BY -> GROUNDS; HAS_POSITION gone and moot). The mechanism is WIELDED and MEASURED: wield_construction.rs furnishes the ordered one-verb set for structure_kind=room AND structure_kind=route (region/connection predicates read from this fixture's kind_profiles), aggregates each through the generic translator (translate_mutation_proposal) into ONE atomic UniverseWriteSet, commits to a FRESH scratch store seeded with canonical-ontology, and proves each by independent readback of the RELATIONS. The bad-set case (a dangling PART_OF endpoint) is rejected by prepare and commits nothing (structure absent, revision unchanged); ZERO new symbols are interned. STILL not done: the toolkit Space itself is not yet written into any canonical store (graph_status not_written), not wired to a live L2 affordance, and not exercised through the embodied/mcp act path — only the write-side mechanism it composes is proven on a scratch store. See wield_construction.rs run output for the measured revisions.

why: The city must be BUILT, not generated, AND WHERE a thing is must be a projection, not a datum: a stored coordinate freezes a position that the layout authority should derive live from the topology; an authored RELATION (PART_OF region; CONNECTS anchors) carries provenance, persists, and means the same thing to every observer, so the meaning survives even as the projected position drifts.

A construction is inherently a SET, not one write: a room is its structure AND its containment AND its attributable Moment; committing them atomically is the only way a half-built structure can never exist.

Making structure_kind DATA rather than native dispatch keeps ONE generic mechanism total over room, route and parcel — a new kind is authored, not coded — honoring the native-floor / Universe-data boundary.

Composing the proven MutationBond primitive (four closed kernel verbs, content-contract enforced) means the toolkit inherits the write-path's guarantees for free instead of opening a second, hidden write path.
Attributing every structure to a construction Moment (PRODUCES) makes construction inspectable and non-anonymous, as the constructed-world-authority invariant requires.
rejected: storing a coordinate (built_position, x/y/z, path, boundary) as placement, because WHERE is a live projection of the topology, never an authored literal
a generated layout as authority, because the algorithm would own the citizen's space and erase spatial memory each tick
one write per construction, because a structure is a set and a partial commit is a half-built structure
a separate builder per structure_kind (HouseBuilder, RoadBuilder, ...) with native dispatch, because the kind is data and one modular toolkit is total over all kinds
a second bespoke write path, because the MutationBond primitive already commits the four closed kernel verbs with a content contract
referencing a route's endpoints as coordinates, because endpoints are OTHER NODES joined by CONNECTS (COMMUNICATES) relations
defaulting a missing geometry field, because an unmeasured extent is Fog, not a zero-size structure

negative_invariants: unknown structure_kind with no field-schema rejected
any coordinate field (built_position / x/y/z / path / boundary) on a structure rejected
structure without a construction Moment that PRODUCES it rejected
non-canonical predicate (HAS_POSITION / CONNECTS / CONSTRUCTED_BY / JUSTIFIED_BY) rejected
route endpoint expressed as a coordinate instead of a CONNECTS relation rejected
dangling PART_OF endpoint (non-existent region) rejects the whole set
invariants: one construction commits exactly one UniverseWriteSet
the set is all-or-nothing (no valid prefix on a bad step)
every BuiltStructure carries provenance 'built' and a construction Moment that PRODUCES it
structure_kind and geometry are read from the graph
placement is relations only — no coordinate is ever written or read
a route CONNECTS (COMMUNICATES) its two anchor nodes
only the four closed kernel verbs are emitted, and only canonical predicates (PART_OF, COMMUNICATES, PRODUCES, GROUNDS) — zero new symbols

content.independence: Reads the source ConstructionBond fixture, the emitted UniverseWriteSet, the committed BuiltStructure and its edges from a FRESH reopen, the field-schema, the acting capability, and the commit receipt. It does not trust a runtime-declared success flag, a renderer preview, a derived coordinate, or the implementation's self-report of graph_status.
checks: atomic all-or-nothing commit (no valid prefix on a bad step)
for a route: two COMMUNICATES edges to the from-anchor and to-anchor nodes present
NO coordinate field (built_position / x / y / z / path / boundary) on the structure content — WHERE is a projection, not a datum
construction Moment present with a Moment PRODUCES structure edge
justification present with a justification GROUNDS structure edge
zero new symbols interned; only canonical predicates emitted
structure_kind and geometry sourced from the graph, not dispatched
content fields (size only) validated against the field-schema
receipt integrity and independent readback match

derivation.healthy: All required fresh scenarios pass: the SAME toolkit built both a room and a route from graph data, each as one atomic set, every structure carried provenance 'built' with a construction Moment (PRODUCES) and a PART_OF region edge, the route CONNECTS its two anchor nodes, no coordinate field appeared on any structure, no fifth verb was emitted, and independent readback matched.
derivation.degraded: Fresh evidence exists but at least one non-catastrophic dimension violates its bound.
derivation.stale: The latest otherwise valid evidence exceeds the configured freshness window.
derivation.unknown: Required evidence cannot be resolved to a known state.
derivation.not_measured: No fresh construction run has measured the required dimensions.
derivation.measurement_failed: The observer or evaluator failed to produce a trustworthy measurement.
